title: poll output
description: The change-detection tuple of every open PR the account authored or was asked to review, over every host in scope. A caller compares the tuple with the one it kept and reads only the PRs that differ. Printed on exit 0, or with `errors` on exit 12 (partial_results).

head_sha.description: The head commit; the empty string for a GitLab merge request with no diff yet.

ci_state.description: The host's own word for the head's CI state (GitHub `statusCheckRollup.state`, GitLab `headPipeline.status`), not the normalized `ci.state`. Null: none. It is compared for equality only.

merge_status.description: GitLab `detailedMergeStatus`; null on GitHub, where `mergeStateStatus` is not polled.

complete.description: false when a host failed, a host cannot be polled lightly (`unsupported`), or a list was cut (`truncated`: more pages than the poll reads, or fewer results than the host counted).

unsupported.description: Hosts that failed the capability probe (an older GitLab). Nothing was read from them; list them with `prs`.

truncated.description: Hosts whose list was cut (more pages than the poll reads, a result the host counted but did not return, or an unusable entry the poll skipped). Their items are there but may be missing some; list them with `prs`.
